title: sse: fix streaming chunking and framing for partial JSON / delimiter ordering
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Fix SSE streaming chunking and event framing that caused partial JSON payloads and delimiter tokens to be emitted in the wrong order. Motivation: downstream OpenAI-compatible clients expect token event ordering and proper delimiter placement to reconstruct partial JSON objects reliably. This PR reworks the chunking pipeline to: 1) ensure that delimiter tokens (data/event separators) are emitted only after the serializer has completed a consistent token boundary, 2) avoid splitting JSON structural tokens (braces/brackets/quotes) across frames whenever possible, 3) add an escape-and-resume strategy for extremely long tokens to keep latency SLOs, and 4) add a compatibility adapter for the openai-compat layer to preserve event ordering for function/tool-calling payloads. Includes regression tests and long-running fuzz tests. Checklist: - Add unit tests for partial JSON reassembly; - Add integration test with openai-compat proxy; - Update docs with compatibility note; - Add changelog entry and release notes. Related: ENG-2743. Impact: fixes a class of production bugs where clients failed to parse partially streamed structured outputs (function/tool-calls or JSON responses). Backwards compatible: yes (behavior fixes only), performance: negligible throughput impact in microbenchmarks (<1% median latency increase for 1-token edge-case reserializations).
